map.按螺杆参数、转速与截面积估算塑料挤出产量与线速度，用于挤出工艺排产与产能核算，纯: Estimate plastic extrusion output and line speed from screw parameters, speed, and cross-section area, for scheduling and capacity; pure-frontend calculation for reference.
map.Q = π/4 × (D² - (D-2h)²) × 螺距 × 转速 × 密度: Q = pi/4 x (D^2 - (D-2h)^2) x pitch x speed x density x efficiency
map.挤出工艺配车时，按螺杆直径、螺槽深度、螺距与转速算螺槽体积流量，结合物料密度与效: In extrusion line setup, compute screw-channel volumetric flow from screw diameter, channel depth, pitch, and speed; combine material density and efficiency for mass output (kg/h) and daily/monthly capacity.
map.设备校核时，用产量估算核对挤出机能力是否匹配订单节拍，避免产能不足或长时间低负荷: In equipment check, use output estimate to verify extruder capacity matches order takt, avoiding short capacity or long low-load runs.
map.工艺调试时，观察产量随转速、螺槽深度的线性/非线性变化，定位加料或漏流短板。: During process tuning, observe linear/nonlinear output change with speed and channel depth to locate feeding or leakage bottlenecks.
map.：螺杆直径 10 mm、螺槽深 1 mm、螺距 5 mm、转速 10 rpm、密: : screw diameter 10 mm, channel depth 1 mm, pitch 5 mm, speed 10 rpm, density 0.92, efficiency 90%. Channel area = pi/4 x (10^2 - (10-2)^2) = pi/4 x 36 approx 28.27 mm^2; displacement per rev 28.27 x 5 approx 141.4 mm^3; 1414 mm^3/min, 23.6 mm^3/s; mass output = 23.6 x 0.92 x 0.90 approx 19.5 g/s approx 70.2 kg/h (lab micro-unit example). Real lines plug larger screw params into the same formula.
map.产量为什么随转速近似线性？: Why does output scale roughly linearly with speed?
map.螺槽体积流量 ∝ 转速（每转排量固定），质量产量 = 体积流量×密度×效率，故在: Screw-channel volumetric flow is proportional to speed (fixed displacement per revolution); mass output = volumetric flow x density x efficiency, so roughly linear with speed when efficiency is stable. At high speed, leakage and shear heating lower actual efficiency.
map.效率系数怎么取？: How to choose the efficiency coefficient?
map.受回料比例、螺杆漏流、加料不均与剪切温升影响，新生产线取 0.85~0.95，老: Affected by return ratio, screw leakage, uneven feeding, and shear heating; take 0.85-0.95 for new lines, lower for aged equipment or high-viscosity material. Calibrate by measurement then backfill to avoid inflated capacity.
